Hello team,

We need to tighten our handoff process for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways because the next wave of departures will leave little room for correction. Passenger guidance must stay concise, kind, and actionable, and every traveler should know what to expect before departure. Keep the language steady and direct, avoid adding extra detail that could slow decisions, and make sure the latest notes are visible to anyone covering the desk. If a case moves from routine to sensitive, flag it at once so we can align the boarding plan without delay. <<FACT F060>>

Please check each file for consistency before the shift changes over. For the travelers already in motion, confirm that the service notes match the booking record, that any special handling is captured, and that the message sent to the customer does not conflict with the lounge or gate instructions. If a pet requires an exception, document the reason in plain terms and pass it forward immediately so the operations line does not stall. This is especially important where the travel desk has already spoken with the customer and the next team is relying on that summary. Use short sentences, keep the tone calm, and do not leave open items unassigned.

I also need everyone to watch for missed follow-up on crate checks, document review, and terminal handoff. If Theo Brown, Nora Ramos, or Loki appear in a case, make sure the traveler note and the animal record are aligned before release, and escalate anything that does not match. We cannot afford confusion at the counter or at boarding, and we should not ask the passenger to repeat information that we already have. Move fast, keep the guidance clean, and close each file only when the path to departure is clear.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
